annotations.title: NOTES:
GENERAL NOTES:
annotations.text:
SLAB: 100 MIN. CONCRETE, LEVEL ±5 OVER THE BASE, 100 MIN. BEYOND THE FRAME.
HOLD-DOWN: TS-401 M12 x 130 SCREW ANCHORS WITH 50 x 50 x 3 WASHERS THROUGH THE BOTTOM PLATES (22 TOTAL), 900 MAX. CRS, 150 MAX. FROM ENDS AND OPENINGS. DPC UNDER THE PLATES.
CLADDING 12 GROOVED EXTERIOR PLY: 50 x 2.8 GALV. NAILS AT 150 CRS AT EDGES, 300 CRS ON INTERMEDIATE STUDS; JOINTS ON STUDS (THE CLADDING BRACES THE FRAME).
ROOF 17 STRUCTURAL PLY ON THE RAFTERS, FALL 1:10 TO THE BACK, NAILED AS THE CLADDING; SELF-ADHERED ROOFING MEMBRANE OVER, DRIP EDGE ALL ROUND.
DOOR: STANDARD 2040 x 820 x 35 SOLID CORE EXTERNAL DOOR (TS-301) IN A 102 x 19 JAMB LINING; 3 / 100 BUTT HINGES, LOCKSET, STOP BEAD AND WEATHER SEAL.
WINDOW: 4 POLYCARBONATE ON GLAZING TAPE BEHIND THE TS-304 FRAME, 8 / 10g x 50 SCREWS.
PAINT ALL EXTERIOR TIMBER: PRIMER AND TWO COATS OF EXTERIOR ACRYLIC.
SHEETS 1-3: GA, EXPLODED VIEW, FLOOR PLAN. SHEETS 4-9: FRAME. THEN THE PARTS.
DIMENSIONS IN MILLIMETRES. DO NOT SCALE.

annotations.title: FIT-OUT:
annotations.text:
WORKBENCH TS-501 (2400) ALONG THE BACK WALL, HARD TO THE RIGHT END WALL; WORKBENCH TS-502 (1200) ALONG THE RIGHT END WALL UNDER THE WINDOW. TOPS 900 ABOVE THE SLAB.
SHELVING UNITS TS-511 (1800 x 300 x 1900, 4 SHELVES) ON THE LEFT END WALL AND THE BACK WALL.
SCREW EACH BENCH AND SHELVING UNIT TO THE WALL STUDS: 2 / 14g x 75 SCREWS PER STUD, AT THE TOP RAIL.
BENCH TOPS: 10g x 50 COUNTERSUNK SCREWS AT 300 CRS INTO THE TOP RAILS. SHELVES: 8g x 40 AT EACH BEARER.

FRAMING 90 x 45 MGP10 SEASONED PINE TO AS/NZS 4063; BOTTOM PLATES 90 x 45 MGP10 H3 TREATED TO AS/NZS 1604.
STUDS AND NOGGINGS: 2 / 75 x 3.05 GALV. NAILS AT EACH END THROUGH THE PLATE OR STUD.
LINTEL 2 / 140 x 45 MGP10 ON EDGE, NAILED TOGETHER AT 300 CRS, BEARING ON THE TRIMMER STUDS.
RAFTERS 90 x 45 MGP10 AT 520 MAX. CRS: A GALV. FRAMING ANCHOR TO EACH TOP PLATE.
DPC UNDER ALL BOTTOM PLATES. WALL FRAMES BUILT FLAT, STOOD, PLUMBED AND NAILED AT THE CORNERS 3 / 75 AT 600 CRS.
SET-OUT DIMENSIONS ARE TO MEMBER FACES FROM THE FRAME'S LEFT AND BOTTOM.
SEAL CUT ENDS OF TREATED TIMBER. KEEP UNTREATED FRAMING DRY.
GENERAL TOLERANCES X ±2, ANG ±1°. DIMENSIONS IN MILLIMETRES. DO NOT SCALE.
annotations.title: NOTES:

views.caption: Back wall frame (seen from the front)

annotations.title: ROOF FRAMING:
annotations.text:
RAFTERS 90 x 45 MGP10, 2311.5 LONG, ENDS CUT SQUARE; OVERHANG 150 PAST THE FRAME FRONT AND BACK, MEASURED LEVEL.
SEAT: THE RAFTERS BEAR ON THE FRONT PLATE'S INNER EDGE AND THE BACK PLATE'S OUTER EDGE (FALL 1:10); PACK OR NOTCH 9 MAX. TO BED FULLY.
FIX EACH RAFTER TO EACH TOP PLATE WITH A GALV. FRAMING ANCHOR AND 6 / 30 x 2.8 NAILS.
ROOF SHEET JOINTS ON RAFTERS 2, 3, 6 AND 9 (FROM THE LEFT): CHECK BEFORE FIXING.

views.caption: Bottom plate and anchor set-out plan

annotations.title: SET-OUT:
annotations.text:
ORIGIN: OUTSIDE FRONT LEFT CORNER OF THE FRAME (FRONT OF THE SHED AT THE BOTTOM OF THIS VIEW).
CHECK DIAGONALS OF THE FRAME: 5385 ±5.
LAY DPC, STAND AND PLUMB THE FRAMES, THEN DRILL Ø12 x 100 DEEP INTO THE SLAB THROUGH EACH PLATE HOLE; BLOW OUT THE DUST; FIT TS-401 ANCHORS WITH THEIR SQUARE WASHERS.
NO ANCHOR WITHIN 100 OF THE SLAB EDGE.
